name: overscroll-touch-wide-fine
description: the same wide width on a fine-pointer desktop window keeps the browser's own document gestures: html computes overscroll-behavior: auto and html/body overflow stay visible, so the desktop lock stays with the phone layout and the coarse-pointer arm never reaches a window with no touch screen

mutation.declaration: styles/global.css: the document gesture lock moved out of its media query to a top-level html rule
mutation.note: Fails: html computes overscroll-behavior: none on a fine-pointer desktop window, so the lock escapes the phone and touching surfaces it was scoped to.
